# watchpoint_environment (Resource)

An environment (such as production, staging or development) that monitors, services, maintenance windows and reports are scoped to. The first environment a tenant creates becomes its default, and every monitor without an `environment_id` belongs to the default. Reads need `environments.read`, writes `environments.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_environment" "production" {
  key           = "production"
  name          = "Production"
  color         = "green"
  is_production = true
  is_default    = true
}

resource "watchpoint_environment" "staging" {
  key         = "staging"
  name        = "Staging"
  color       = "amber"
  reassign_to = watchpoint_environment.production.id
}

resource "watchpoint_http_monitor" "staging_api" {
  name           = "Staging API"
  url            = "https://staging.example.com/health"
  environment_id = watchpoint_environment.staging.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Stable key: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, not `default`. Used by alert routing `Environment` conditions. Changing it replaces the environment.
- `name` (String) Display name (64 characters max).

### Optional

- `color` (String) Chip color: `slate`, `green`, `amber`, `blue`, `violet` or `rose`. Defaults to `slate`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default environment. Set `true` to make it the default; the previous default is cleared, so set it on one environment only. Only `true` is accepted: omit it elsewhere. The first environment created is the default automatically.
- `is_production` (Boolean) Marks the environment as production. Defaults to `false`.
- `reassign_to` (String) Environment ID that monitors and services in this environment move to when it is destroyed. Required to destroy an environment that is still in use. The default environment cannot be destroyed.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position in pickers and filters (0 to 100000). When omitted the server appends it after the others.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Environment ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_environment.staging env_0192f0c1
```
